notes:
Summary: Borealis is building a cross-lingual enterprise search product for legal teams and support centers. Primary pain: inconsistent recall across languages and high cost when using cross-encoder rerankers at scale. Wants a solution that balances per-query latency and per-language precision targets.

Key constraints / asks: 
- Index scale: 100M-300M documents (doc shards + versioning).
- Languages: EN primary, FR/DE secondary, ES/JP lower-volume but must not degrade recall. Need per-language evals and tuning guidance.
- Throughput/latency: target 150 QPS peak, 95th percentile retrieval+rerank <350ms for EU region; acceptable fallback path for high-load (approx degrade to cheaper vector-only results).
- Cost sensitivity: legal product margin tight; wants cost-per-query modeling for different deployment configs (dedicated GPU pools vs hosted + hybrid caching).
- Model preferences: open to multilingual transformer embeddings (LaBSE / XLM-R variants) + cross-encoder reranker for top-100 -> top-5 re-rank. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization and batching.
- Routing/fallback: must support region-based routing (EU-residency) and automatic fallback to smaller model variant when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS for key management, strict retention policies per EU law.

CRM-style notes from calls: 
- "We have pockets of documents in French where recall drops by ~18% vs English — unacceptable for compliance." (Head of Search, call 2026-01-12)
- "If reranker cost is >0.5c/query we break the unit economics" (Product lead)
- SE notes: prefer a dual-stage pipeline: dense retrieval (multilingual embeddings) -> light cross-encoder rerank on top-K with selective reranking thresholds.

POC specifics requested: 
- Deliver baseline recall/precision per language on a 10M doc sample (EN/FR/DE/ES/JP).
- Provide cost-per-query projections for: (a) Dedicated (reserved GPUs) with batching, (b) Hosted+cache (prefix + KV cache) with fallback, (c) Hybrid with on-prem VPC nodes for EU-only data.
- Show p95 latency for retrieval-only and retrieval+rerank at 50/100/150 QPS.

Next steps notes: 
- Priya to run embedding vector baseline with Redwood hosted trial models for EN/FR/DE by 2026-03-07.
- Jordan to get draft SOW to legal for residency language by 2026-03-14.
- SE will prepare recommended quantization + batching settings (target int8 where possible) and expected quality delta.
